name: Dong Yuan
summary:
Dong Yuan, courtesy name Shuda (叔達), was a Chinese painter of the Southern Tang dynasty.

Born in unknown circumstances, Dong Yuan flourished during the reign of Emperor Gaozong (942–975 CE). His artistic talents were nurtured under the guidance of renowned painters and scholars of his time. As a prominent artist of his era, Dong Yuan's work embodied the aesthetic values of the Southern Tang dynasty.

Dong Yuan's creative legacy extends beyond his own lifetime, influencing generations of Chinese artists to come. His style, characterized by subtle brushstrokes and delicate color palettes, has left an enduring mark on the development of Chinese art.

The exact date of Dong Yuan's death remains unknown, but his contributions to the world of art continue to inspire and captivate audiences today.
